description.value: Number E Food is a chef-inspired gourmet sandwich shop that has been serving downtown Vancouver's Burrard Street corridor for over 13 years, specializing in artisanal sandwiches on house-made focaccia and Tuscan bread sourced from local purveyors including Two Rivers Meats. Beyond sandwiches, the shop offers fresh salads, soups, take-home meals, a cookie bar, and Moja coffee roasted on the North Shore. Eat-in and takeout are both available, with vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free choices catering to a broad range of dietary needs.
